briefings.title: Brazil's Lula Reveals Key Details of Meeting With Trump – Trade Deals, Tariffs & Cooperation | AC1N
briefings.tldr: President Lula and President Trump have established a high-level working group with a 30-day deadline to resolve trade and tariff disputes, while signaling a renewed strategic partnership centered on critical minerals, infrastructure investment, and global security.

briefings.title: FULL REMARKS: Brazil's Lula Talks U.S. Relations, Trump Meeting, Trade, Tariff & Global Order | AC1N
briefings.tldr: President Lula characterized his three-hour meeting with Donald Trump as a breakthrough in consolidating Brazil-US relations, highlighted by a new 30-day mandate to resolve trade disputes and a proposed joint task force to combat the financial structures of organized crime.
